summary: Mined 5 competitor repos (OpenEvolve, ShinkaEvolve, DGM, GEPA, SICA) for 14 techniques, each mapped to our modules with file-level evidence; clones deleted. Top 3 recommended adoptions: (1) Stage-0 cascade gate — optional pre_check in the metric spec (measure.js) so a cheap build/test gate short-circuits broken attempts before the full benchmark, the single largest token save; (2) Artifacts feed-forward — persist measure stderr + guardrail deltas + judge diagnosis in verdicts and inject into the next iterate prompt (textual gradient), turning 1-bit losses into rich signal; (3) Novelty rejection of repeat attempts — reuse lib/embed.js MiniLM to bounce near-duplicates of failed attempts before any measure spend, mechanically enforcing 'propose a different change'. Also in top-5: DGM-style stuck-recovery (one branch-from-earlier-commit round before escalating) and problem-close learning notes + token/wall-time cost guardrails. Per sibling C2, the strategy-selection slot should be the cross-epoch Elo ladder (fits our pairwise judge verdicts) rather than ShinkaEvolve bandits, which starve at 2-3 attempts/round. Explicit skips: islands/migration, MAP-Elites, static LLM ensemble weights, full per-instance Pareto fronts (all assume populations 100x our scale). Full report: /Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude/scratch/competitive/C3-adoptable-techniques.md

item.title: T1 Stage-0 cascade gate (OpenEvolve/DGM/GEPA)
item.value: Add optional pre_check (stage-0) command to inline metric spec in measure.js: cheap build/unit-test gate runs before full measure_command+guardrails; failure short-circuits (no full measure, no judge) but records a cheap-loss verdict so optimize.js stuck-counting still works. Evidence: openevolve/evaluator.py _cascade_evaluate L360-460 (cascade_thresholds), dgm/DGM_outer.py get_full_eval_threshold L192-221, gepa strategies/acceptance.py StrictImprovementAcceptance L39. Cost S, adopt-now.

item.title: T2 Artifacts feed-forward / textual gradient (OpenEvolve+GEPA+DGM)
item.value: Persist measure stderr, per-guardrail baseline->measured deltas, and a judge qualitative diagnosis in an artifacts field on verdicts; daemon.js applyOptimize already feeds prior verdict forward on iterate — include artifacts so round N+1's proposer sees WHY round N lost (text replaces gradient). Evidence: openevolve/evaluation_result.py EvaluationResult.artifacts L13-40, gepa proposer/reflective_mutation/reflective_mutation.py L66-300 (capture_traces+reflect), dgm/self_improve_step.py diagnose_improvement L69. Cost S, adopt-now — highest learning-per-token at 2-3 attempts/round.

item.title: T3 Novelty rejection sampling (ShinkaEvolve)
item.value: Embed each attempt's plan/diff summary with existing lib/embed.js MiniLM; on optimize iterate, reject a new attempt whose embedding is near-duplicate of a prior FAILED attempt before paying worktree/measure cost ('you already tried X, propose differently'). Mechanically enforces optimize.js L93's 'propose a DIFFERENT change'. Evidence: shinka/core/novelty_judge.py assess_novelty_with_rejection_sampling L26-160 (cosine gate + optional cheap LLM novelty tiebreak, resample with different parent). Cost M, zero new deps, adopt-now.

item.title: T4 Stuck-recovery archive branch (DGM)
item.value: Before optimize.js 'stuck' escalates to human, allow ONE recovery round branching a worktree from an EARLIER merged commit (git history = keep-all archive; lib/git.js already supports arbitrary refs) with an explicitly different strategy; only escalate if recovery also fails. Inspired by DGM's open-ended archive parent selection: DGM_outer.py choose_selfimproves L50-150 (sigmoid(score) x 1/(1+children) 'score_child_prop'), update_archive keep_all L174; polished version shinka/database/parents.py L370-400 (MAD-normalized sigmoid x novelty bonus). Cost M, adopt-now in bounded form; full archive sampling skipped (needs populations).

item.title: T5 Problem-close learning notes + cost guardrails (ShinkaEvolve MetaSummarizer + SICA utility)
item.value: (a) When optimize closes a problem (converged/stuck), auto-distill a 'what worked / what didn't' knowledge note wired via context edges so future problems on the same repo inherit it (cross-problem transfer = our differentiator per B4). Evidence: shinka/core/summarizer.py MetaSummarizer (periodic meta-LLM recs + global scratchpad injected into prompts, async_runner.py L1476-1491). (b) Add attempt_tokens + wall_time_s as implicit guardrail-shaped values in measure.js so the judge's near-veto rejects wins that doubled cost. Evidence: SICA base_agent/src/utils/archive_analysis.py BenchmarkScore.utility L63-86 (score IF cost<=limit AND time<=limit ELSE 0); DGM noise_leeway=0.1. Cost S-M, adopt-now. Strategy-selection slot afterwards: prefer sibling C2's cross-epoch Elo ladder over ShinkaEvolve bandits (llm/prioritization.py AsymmetricUCB/ThompsonSampler) — Elo matches our pairwise judge verdicts; bandits starve at 2-3 attempts/round.
